Definition
[Suspension]

\group Homotopy Theory For a space $X$, its suspension $SX$ is $(X\times I)/(X\times \{ 0\} )/(X\times \{ 1\} )$, with the two collapsed sets becoming distinct suspension points. In particular $SS^n\cong S^{n+1}$, and a map $f:X\to Y$ induces $Sf:SX\to SY$ from $f\times I$. If $X$ is a CW complex, so are $SX$ and the cone below.
